name: Srinagar to Ladakh Adventure
description: Experience the dramatic journey from Kashmir's lush greenery to Ladakh's stark high-altitude desert. This carefully curated itinerary covers Srinagar, Kargil, Leh, Nubra Valley, and the stunning Pangong Lake — a complete Himalayan experience.
route: Srinagar → Sonmarg → Zoji La → Drass → Kargil → Lamayuru → Leh → Khardung La → Nubra Valley → Pangong Lake → Chang La → Leh
highlights: Shikara ride on the iconic Dal Lake
Scenic drive through Zoji La Pass
Visit to ancient monasteries like Lamayuru, Hemis & Thiksey
Drive across Khardung La – one of the highest motorable roads
Camel safari in Nubra Valley sand dunes
Visit to the stunning Pangong Lake

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Srinagar Airport and transfer to your hotel or houseboat. Visit Mughal Gardens such as Nishat Bagh and Shalimar Bagh. In the evening, enjoy a peaceful Shikara ride on Dal Lake. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Kargil
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive towards Kargil via Sonmarg and Zoji La Pass. En route, visit Drass Village and the War Memorial. Reach Kargil by evening and check into the hotel.

itinerary.title: Kargil to Leh
itinerary.desc: Proceed to Leh after breakfast. Visit Mulbekh Buddha statue, Lamayuru Monastery, Moonland landscapes, Indus-Zanskar Sangam, Magnetic Hill, and Gurudwara Pathar Sahib. Evening visit to Leh Market, Shanti Stupa, and Leh Palace. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Full day exploring Leh. Visit Hemis Monastery, Thiksey Monastery, Shey Palace, and Rancho School (3 Idiots fame). Evening at leisure in Leh Market. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.desc: Drive to Nubra Valley via Khardung La Pass. Visit Diskit Monastery and Hunder Sand Dunes. Optional camel safari on double-humped camels. Overnight stay in Nubra.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Lake via Shyok Route
itinerary.desc: Scenic drive along Shyok River. Reach Pangong Lake and explore surroundings. Overnight stay at Pangong (camp/cottage). Route subject to weather conditions.

itinerary.title: Pangong to Leh & Departure
itinerary.desc: Return journey via Chang La Pass. Visit Shey Palace and Thiksey Monastery en route. Transfer to Leh Airport. Departure with unforgettable memories.

inclusions: 3 Nights stay in Leh with breakfast & dinner
1 Night stay in Nubra Valley with meals
1 Night stay in Pangong with meals
1 Night stay in Kargil with meals
1 Night stay in Srinagar with meals
Parking, toll taxes, and fuel charges
exclusions: Adventure activities (rafting, camel safari, ATV, etc.)
Extra costs due to delays, weather, or roadblocks
